note: Hits are places to read, not findings. Answer each hit's ask before citing it.

hits.title: Path sandbox enforced by string prefix
hits.ask: Is the path resolved (realpath/resolve, symlinks followed) before the check, and does the prefix end with a separator so `/work-evil` doesn't pass a `/work` check?

hits.title: Allow-all CIDR
hits.ask: Is this an egress rule for the agent's workload? Allowing every destination means the egress allowlist is not enforced here.

hits.title: securityContext to check for missing hardening
hits.ask: Does this securityContext set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and drop ALL capabilities? A missing field defaults to the permissive value.

hits.title: Timeout or budget defined
hits.ask: Search for every read of this name: is it actually passed to the call or loop it should bound, and does exceeding it stop the run outside the model's control?

hits.title: Cache keyed without user or tenant
hits.ask: Does the cache key include the tenant and user? If not, one tenant's answer or tool result can be served to another.
